correctness.rationale: The independent-triple enumeration gives an exact cone-plus-simplex decomposition for every n>=6. The intersection is explicitly described using two rim neighbor-pairs, and two contractible-cover homotopy pushouts yield S^{n-5}. The n=6 and one-element-U cases are handled separately. The extracted finite checker confirms face equalities and mod-two Betti ranks for all 266 pair configurations with 6<=n<=12. The unrestricted theorem rests on the symbolic decomposition, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The smallest possible number of missing hub incidences that can admit an independent triple containing the hub is two. The theorem resolves the full two-fault geometry and gives an unbounded-dimensional sphere precisely for nonadjacent faults, contrasted with adjacent-fault contractibility; this is a structurally motivated threshold, not an arbitrary finite slice or a known-table recomputation.
